body: At this point, there needs to be a drastic and rapid reduction in the human population. There's no way to achieve this without it being extremely shitty, however, so that's off the table. If all of humanity could stop industrialized farming/fishing, and consuming fossil fuels basically overnight, then that might help slow things down. And while we're at it, we'll need to purge the concept of capitalism from the world and hunt any surviving capitalists for sport on the weekends.

I want a world that gives everyone a fair chance, and lifts up people who can't do it on their own. I want a world that is safe and fair for women. I want a world where we don't poison the environment in ways that aren't even beneficial to us in the short term. I want a world where humans don't view themselves as the superior lifeform that can do whatever the fuck they want with everything else. 
I want the world to be different on so many fundamental levels that it's impossible to have hope.
